Recorded claim:
The loader remains create/edit-first: read-dialog compatibility is planned, not an implementation authorization. Calendar transactions and reminder/RSVP mutations are owner/controller work outside the shared loader. Draft state resets from a loaded source, tracks dirty sections, and must not mutate the source item before Save. [Task 2]
